releaseNotes:
Includes the current improvements from v1.17.69 onward, plus the new features below.

**Ticketmaster — easier section selection**

• **One simple list:** Selected Sections now shows a flat, naturally sorted list with individual price limits. Selected Categories remains available separately.
• **Combine section filters:** Choose GA, Floor and numbered levels such as 100s, 400s and 600s together. Supported venues can show Lower Level and Upper Level instead. Only relevant chips appear; unclassified sections remain under All.
• **Search your sections:** Use Search or Enter to find section names, levels or several sections at once, such as 101, 114-2. Search narrows the active chip filters and ignores an optional S prefix on numbered sections.
• **Clear selection controls:** Select all results or Clear all results affects only the displayed sections. Clear all sections unchecks everything, including hidden selections, without deleting price limits. Filtering keeps other selections saved. Accessible seating stays hidden and excluded by default.

**Ticketmaster — smarter monitoring**

• **Cycle through matches:** Turn on Cycle through matches after retries with Maximum available to try supported quantities down to your minimum, then move to the next matching listing. For example: 8 → 6 → 4 → 2 → next match. With the toggle off, the same matching listing keeps its existing retry behavior. Uncertain responses still stop for review.
• **Faster list loading:** Load more tickets automatically checks arriving batches without the old fixed multi-second pauses. A due refresh waits until the scan finishes instead of sending you back to the top early.
• **Clear loading failures:** Stalled loading stops with an Incomplete scan message. Review the list and press Start to retry. Actual speed still depends on Ticketmaster.
• **Simpler quantity settings:** Minimum quantity controls singles automatically: 1 allows single tickets; 2 or higher excludes them. Fixed quantity is unchanged. Lower Level labels no longer show the inferred suffix.

**Ticketmaster — login and Get Tickets protection**

• **Primary and resale sign-in:** Recognized sign-in redirects after your active ticket request stop clicking and notify Sign-in required — continue your booking. The popup keeps your selected quantity, section, row and price visible and copyable instead of staying on Trying / Reconnecting. Existing alert preferences apply.
• **Protected Get Tickets handoff:** Manually pressing Get Tickets on the held-ticket review screen locks automatic clicks, retries and refreshes, including delayed actions. Manual Search Again works, but Start/F9 from a usable selection page is required to restart clicking. Already-sent requests cannot be cancelled by this safeguard.
• **Cleaner ticket status:** Cancelling held tickets returns to Ready without an unnecessary warning or automatic restart. Old reservation cards stay hidden while saved details remain in diagnostics. Copied details use 2x tickets / 1x ticket and omit unknown totals while keeping real totals.

**Ticketek Marketplace**

• **Fewer unnecessary pauses:** Unrelated help controls and unchanged inputs no longer pause retries. Real listing selections, Buy actions, navigation and selection changes still pause safely.
• **Final check before Buy:** Clickerist rechecks the listing, event, quantity and price immediately before automatic Buy. Pause messages and diagnostics explain the recognized trigger more clearly.
• **Retry Open Ticketek link:** The helper stays available while idle even if an earlier scan failed. Clicking it checks again for a verified matching event link. It remains disabled during clicking or scanning; missing links show clearer guidance.

**Clearer updates and troubleshooting**

• **Easier release notes:** What’s new uses bold headings, readable bullets and cleaner spacing.
• **Saved failure evidence:** Get Tickets diagnostics include click timing, hold time, page changes and extension actions. The latest failure survives reloads and later runs. Clear log keeps this evidence; Clear evidence deletes it.
• **Private by default:** Diagnostics are copied only when you choose; nothing uploads automatically. Login credentials and payment information are not collected.

**After updating**

Reload Clickerist and refresh your ticket tabs. Review your section selections, enable automatic loading to scan beyond loaded listings, and enable retry cycling if wanted. Approve the Ticketmaster sign-in-site permission if prompted.

Sign-in and payment remain manual. Reaching login does not confirm a current hold or purchase. Ticketmaster may still reject unavailable tickets; this update does not guarantee a successful reservation or fix every site-side error.

**Have feedback?**

Found a bug or have a feature request? **Send feedback through Clickerist.** Include your version, steps, screenshot and Copy diagnostics where available. Review diagnostics before sharing.
